title: Rust Gazelle manifest metadata
description: Use this object in package.metadata.rules_rs or workspace.metadata.rules_rs. Package fields replace workspace defaults, including empty lists and maps.

library_compile_data.description: Extra library and binary compiler inputs. Cargo's package.readme is automatic.

unit_compile_data.description: Extra unit-test compiler inputs. Unit tests also inherit library compiler inputs.

test_compile_data.description: Extra integration-test compiler inputs. Cargo's package.readme is automatic.

test_data.description: Integration-test runtime inputs. Generated binary runfiles are automatic.

build_compile_data.description: Compiler inputs for the build script.

build_data.description: Build-script runtime inputs. Labels from build_inputs are automatic.

testonly.description: Set testonly on all generated targets.

dep_override.description: Replace dependency and alias labels that start with the repository prefix.

build_inputs.description: Map environment variable names to build-script files. Cargo keeps environment overrides. Conflicting workspace-wide mappings cause an error.

cargo_path.description: A clean repository-relative file path. Do not use absolute paths, parent traversal, or backslashes. Generation does not require the file to exist.

bazel_label.description: A Bazel label for one file. The generator adds the label to build-script data and uses execpath.

inputs.description: Bazel labels, package-relative file paths, or package-relative glob patterns. Entries retain their existing Bazel meaning.
